senses.definition_en: once in a while; occasionally

examples.english: That he just saw the two of them i.e. the brothers, that he saw the other rarely i.e. Manuel, that these are the names the man gave him, that he had seen them once in a while i.e. very few times, that he found him on the street, […]
examples.ref: 2005 July 7, José Angel Carbajal Salguero, “0901-53-2005”, in Tribunal de Sentencia, Chalatenango, archived from the original on 13 Aug 2026:
examples.text: Que a los dos ellos los veía nada mas, o sea los hermanos, que al otro no lo había visto mas seguido o sea Manuel, que estos son los nombres que le dio el señor, que los había visto en dionde o sea pocas veces, que lo encontraba en la calle, […]
examples.translation: That he just saw the two of them i.e. the brothers, that he saw the other rarely i.e. Manuel, that these are the names the man gave him, that he had seen them once in a while i.e. very few times, that he found him on the street, […]

examples.english:
Seven women said that, if they have remittance of money [from another coutnry], this aid is not steady, it's temporary, and the money sent varies between 50-150 dollars yearly.
 […]
S59 (75 years): “Like that, once in a while (occasionally).” “Every three months.” “Just fifty dollars.”
examples.ref: 2017, Ana Sandra Aguilar de Mendoza, El estado de las competencias de desarrollo de la mujer en la zona de La Libertad, San Salvador: Technological University of El Salvador, →ISBN, page 91:
examples.text:
Siete mujeres expresaron que, si reciben remesa, este apoyo no es estable, es temporal, y lo enviado oscila entre los 50-150.00 dólares al año.
[…]
S59 (75 años): “Así, endionde (de vez en cuando).” “Cada tres meses.” “No más cincuenta.”
examples.translation:
Seven women said that, if they have remittance of money [from another coutnry], this aid is not steady, it's temporary, and the money sent varies between 50-150 dollars yearly.
 […]
S59 (75 years): “Like that, once in a while (occasionally).” “Every three months.” “Just fifty dollars.”

examples.english: Then, during one of his forced naps due to rickets and malnutrition, Nerón felt coming through the air a fragrance unknown until then, to him it tasted better than the scant food or the leftovers of some wild animal they hunted for food in the home now and then.
examples.ref: 2023 December 6, Alí Adolfo Castaneda, “El Hijo de Nerón”, in Las Tertulias de Alí Castaneda y amigos, archived from the original on 13 Aug 2026:
examples.text: Entonces, en una de sus siestas obligadas por el raquitismo y la desnutrición, Nerón sintió venir por el aire una fragancia desconocida hasta entonces, le supo mejor que la escasa comida o sobras de algún animal montés que cazaban para alimento en la casa allá endionde.
examples.translation: Then, during one of his forced naps due to rickets and malnutrition, Nerón felt coming through the air a fragrance unknown until then, to him it tasted better than the scant food or the leftovers of some wild animal they hunted for food in the home now and then.

glosses: once in a while; occasionally

senses.definition_en: a ground-level seat used by Aztec rulers in the manner of a throne

examples.english: Headrest [of an] equipal that serves as a pillow. tzonicpalli.
examples.ref: 1555, Alonso de Molina, Aqui comienca vn vocabulario en la lengua castellana y mexicana, f. 38v:
examples.text: Cabecera ycpal que ſirue por almohada. tzonicpalli.
examples.translation: Headrest [of an] equipal that serves as a pillow. tzonicpalli.

examples.english: “Xochiatzin, come sit by my side, daughter!” indicating a seat with her hand.
examples.ref: 2011, Juanita Delgadillo Ramírez, El despertar de la conciencia tolteca, Palibrio, page 33:
examples.text: ¡Xochiatzin, hija ven siéntate a mi lado! señalando un equipal con su mano.
examples.translation: “Xochiatzin, come sit by my side, daughter!” indicating a seat with her hand.

examples.english: The stagehands place some bushes and a seat
examples.roman: Los tramoyistas colocan unos arbustos y un equipal
examples.text: Marcelo del Río, El sueño dela Malinche in 2007, Román Calvo, Viajero sin equipaje y otras obras, Editorial Pax México, page 57
examples.translation: The stagehands place some bushes and a seat

glosses: a ground-level seat used by Aztec rulers in the manner of a throne

senses.definition_en: a type of reed or wicker chair with a leather-sheathed seat and back

examples.english: Naturally flexible but at the same time resistant, they are the most well suited for furniture, frames, seats, cages, toys, baskets for harvesting and washing farm produce (coffee, cocoa, chili, pepper, etc.), handleless baskets and mats, among other things, manufactured after eight to eleven previous stages.
examples.ref: 1988, Marta Turok, Cómo acercarse a la artesania, Editorial Plaza y Janés, page 71:
examples.text: Flexibles por naturaleza pero a la vez resistentes, son las más aptas para muebles, armazones, equipales, jaulas, juguetes, canastas para cosechar y lavar productos agrícolas (café, cacao, chile, pimienta, etc.), chiquihuites y petates, entre otros, elaborados después de ocho a once fases previas.
examples.translation: Naturally flexible but at the same time resistant, they are the most well suited for furniture, frames, seats, cages, toys, baskets for harvesting and washing farm produce (coffee, cocoa, chili, pepper, etc.), handleless baskets and mats, among other things, manufactured after eight to eleven previous stages.

glosses: a type of reed or wicker chair with a leather-sheathed seat and back
